resolutions.target_artifact: openspec/changes/foundation-and-packaging/design.md — Decision 6, 'Manual load check' (lines 193–216); tasks.md (Stage 5, acceptance task) carries the recipe
resolutions.rationale: Minor and correct on altitude: zoom-out standard §4 puts mechanics in tasks.md, and Decision 6 now holds a shell runbook. It landed there for a reason the record shows — COMP-1/COMP-2 (Stage 2) found the check had no pass/fail rule and no reversible controls, and critic-r1-3 (Stage 3) moved it off the live tree; tasks.md did not exist, so the remedies were written into the design. Nothing in those fixes was a design decision beyond the contract; the shell lines, `out.txt`, the exact replacement strings and the re-extract undo are execution mechanics. Moving them changes no decision, no config value, no spec scenario, and no owner ruling (Q2(a)'s throwaway agent directory stays in the contract). Recorded, not blocking: Bambadjan applies the move in the STAGE-3-TIDY pass before tasks.md is drafted, so Stage 5 has one home for the recipe instead of a copy. If the move is skipped, Stage 5 will raise the duplication itself when tasks.md carries the commands.
resolutions.evidence: zoom-out-standard.md §4 line 31: 'Pseudocode, helper internals, and loop mechanics belong out of design.md and inside tasks.md'. michael-resolve-s1s2.json COMP-1/COMP-2 required_change wrote the command block and controls into Decision 6 because 'tasks.md and design.md do not exist yet' (readiness R-07's own note) — the content they fixed was the contract (positive proof Pi ran; text assertion; reversible controls), not the shell. michael-resolve-s3-r1.json critic-r1-3 and s3-r2 critic-r2-3 added `git archive`, `cd "$D"`, re-extract undo: all mechanics. design.md:193–216 as of HEAD 90d8f20.

settled_findings: ZO-S4-1 (minor): Decision 6's manual-check recipe moves to tasks.md; the design keeps the contract. Recorded as part of STAGE-3-TIDY, applied before tasks.md is drafted. Fresh rounds do not re-open it; Stage 5 verifies tasks.md carries the recipe.

DECISION-6-CONTRACT (what design.md keeps, replacing lines 195–216 with one paragraph): 'The manual check verifies the committed tree, never the live checkout: a `git archive HEAD` copy in a `mktemp -d` directory serves as both the package Pi loads (via a `settings.json` `packages` entry naming the copy) and `PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR`, and Pi runs with the copy as its working directory. No `npm install` is needed (Pi maps host packages to its own copies). Pass is three observations on captured, unfiltered output of `pi --no-session --help`: Pi's usage header is present (proof Pi ran — a filtered pipeline is silent on a missing command too); neither `Failed to load extension` nor `Host-provided extension packages` appears; and two negative controls, each applied inside the copy and undone by re-extracting the archive, each produce their diagnostic — a restored `throw` in one handler produces the load error, and the host package added to `dependencies` (no install) produces the warning. Never assert on the exit code: `--help` exits 0 whether or not an extension loaded (R6). Record `pi --version` (1.5.2 measured). The literal command sequence lives in tasks.md's acceptance task.' Prerequisite sentence (Node 26.8.1, npm 11.19.0, Pi 1.5.2, rg) stays.

TASKS-MD-MUST-CARRY (for Stage 5): the acceptance task reproduces design.md's former lines 197–216 verbatim as the literal recipe: `D=$(mktemp -d)`; `git archive HEAD | tar -x -C "$D"`; `cd "$D"`; `printf '{"packages":[%s]}' "$(node -p 'JSON.stringify(process.argv[1])' "$D")" > "$D/settings.json"`; `PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR="$D" pi --no-session --help > out.txt 2>&1`; `head -1 out.txt` (expects `pi - AI coding assistant …`); `rg -c 'Failed to load extension|Host-provided extension packages' out.txt` (expects no output, exit 1); Control A: in `$D/src/infra/pi-event-handlers/session-tree.ts` replace `_pi.on("session_tree", () => {});` with `throw new Error("Not implemented: registerSessionTreeHandler");`, re-run, `rg -c 'Failed to load extension' out.txt` → `1`, undo with `git -C <repo> archive HEAD | tar -x -C "$D"`; Control B: in `$D/package.json` add `"dependencies": { "@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent": "*" }`, no `npm install`, re-run, `rg -c 'Host-provided extension packages' out.txt` → `1`, undo as above; `rm -rf "$D"`; record `pi --version`. Run after the stub-edit commit. The settings.json hand-off (Migration step 2) stays Joel's and is not a ticked task.
STAGE-3-TIDY (carried from michael-resolve-s3-r3.json, unchanged, plus ZO-S4-1): apply in one non-blocking pass before tasks.md.
